summary: United Community Banks Inc. (UCB) filed an 8-K announcing a joint press release with Peach State Bancshares regarding the pending merger. Peach State shareholders have until July 20, 2026, to elect their form of consideration (cash or stock) per the Merger Agreement dated April 20, 2026. All regulatory approvals have been received, and closing is expected on August 3, 2026, subject to Peach State shareholder approval and other conditions. The deal is a strategic bank acquisition. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and any last-minute election preference shifts that could affect deal economics.
